manifest.name: dsh-closet-tracker
manifest.description: Closet Tracker for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: your clothing wishlist (prices, drops, brands) from a local Bun app, as a native Harness panel.
manifest.author: ramanasai

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: closet-tracker
      name: dsh-closet-tracker
      config:
        # Where the local Closet Tracker app listens. The Host half proxies the
        # panel's /closet-api requests here, so the page needs no CORS grant.
        # `localhost` reaches an IPv4 or IPv6 loopback listener.
        baseUrl: http://localhost:3003

readme.text:
Your clothing wishlist, in two shapes from one repo:

- **A zero-dependency Bun web app** ([`app/`](app/)) — paste a product link and
  track it: image, name, price, store, brand, category, price history, outfits,
  gaps, palette, PDF export, PWA. Runs normally in any browser.
- **A native DeepSeek Harness plugin** (this package, repo root) — a hanger icon
  in the Harness left sidebar and a full wishlist panel in the main column,
  reading the same local data.

- **The real closet** — reads the same `app/data/items.json` the web app uses, so
  items added in either place show up in both.
- **Paste a link to add** — the app scrapes name, image, price, store, brand and
  category; the piece appears in the grid immediately.
- **Stats** — wishlist value, pieces still wanted, bought count, and price drops
  since the last check.
- **Filter, search, sort** — status tabs (All / Wishlist / Bought), category
  chips, free-text search, sort by newest, price, name or biggest drop.
- **Per-piece actions** — check the price now, flip wishlist ↔ bought, remove
  (two-step confirm).
- **Sync all** — re-scrapes every tracked link and reports the price drops.
- **Native look** — theme tokens only, so light and dark follow the Harness;
  empty/offline states that say what to do; quiet auto-retry every 12 s while
  the local app is down.

Requires [Bun](https://bun.sh) (no `bun install` needed):

```bash
cd app
bun run start          # http://localhost:3003
open http://localhost:3003
```

Requires DeepSeek Harness (built against `0.2.1-rc.5`) with a profile, plus Bun
for the app.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ramanasai/dsh-closet-tracker.git
```

Install the bundle from the clone — the target is the **absolute path of the
clone** (the repo root *is* the plugin package):

```
plugin_manager install_bundle target=/absolute/path/to/dsh-closet-tracker
```

or use the Plugin Manager UI in Harness (install a bundle from a local
directory) and pick the same path.

**Or install the released package** (no clone needed): download
`dsh-closet-tracker-1.0.0.tgz` from [Releases](https://github.com/ramanasai/dsh-closet-tracker/releases)
and pass the tarball itself as the target — this path is verified to install and
activate:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle target=/absolute/path/to/dsh-closet-tracker-1.0.0.tgz
```

The sidebar then shows a hanger icon labelled **Closet Tracker**; the app must be
running for the panel to show data. If the Harness page was already open before
installing, reload it once.

The upstream origin lives in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: closet-tracker
      name: dsh-closet-tracker
      config:

Run the app on another port (`PORT=4000 bun run start`) and set `baseUrl` to
match. The default `3003` is the app's own default (`process.env.PORT || 3003`).

| Piece | Registration |
| --- | --- |
| `sidebar.panellist` | `id: closet-tracker`, `order: 30`, hanger icon, localized `label` thunk |
| `main` | `key: closet-tracker` → the wishlist panel |
| Host route | `prefix /closet-api` on the Harness web server |

**Why a Host proxy?** The app is a separate local process that sends no CORS
headers, and Harness plugin guidance forbids embedding pages in an iframe. So the
Host half ([`index.js`](index.js)) registers one same-origin proxy route that the
Client half ([`client.js`](client.js)) calls as `/closet-api/api/...`:

The Client half renders React from the Harness module table, uses only
`--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens, and registers all visible text through the Harness
locale service.

```
package.json          DSH bundle manifest (repo root = the plugin package)
cordis.patch.yml      Loader row inserted into the profile (+ baseUrl)
index.js              Host half: the authenticated /closet-api proxy
client.js             Client half: sidebar entry + wishlist panel

```bash
npm test                          # node --test: proxy forwarding, allowlist, gate, header hygiene
node --check index.js client.js   # syntax
cd app && bun run start           # run the app itself
```

The proxy tests start their own stub upstream, so they need neither Bun nor the
real app.

| Symptom | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| *"Closet Tracker is not reachable at http://localhost:3003"* | Start the app (`cd app && bun run start`). The panel retries by itself every 12 s, or press **Try again**. |
| Sidebar icon missing after install | Reload the Harness page once so the new client module generation loads. |
| Panel shows data for the wrong app | `baseUrl` in `cordis.patch.yml` must match the app's port. |
| Port already in use | `cd app && make stop` (frees `PORT`, default 3003), or start with another `PORT` and update `baseUrl`. |
| Amazon / Ajio links scrape poorly | Expected — both block bots. The item is added; fill in details with the app's edit dialog (✏️). |
| `make stop` killed something else | It kills whatever listens on the app's `PORT`; check `lsof -nP -iTCP:3003 -sTCP:LISTEN`. |
